testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between temporary compact ribbon groups: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:130:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between temporary compact ribbon groups ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Place Views ribbon shows compact group buttons ✔ When the user selects the Create group button ✔ Then a temporary Create panel displays drawing-view commands ✔ When the user selects the Modify group button ✔ Then the Create panel closes ✔ And a temporary Modify panel displays modification commands ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the drawing outside the panel ✔ Then the temporary Modify panel closes ✔ And the compact group buttons remain visible
